description: This file is an HTML document with embedded JavaScript, serving as a plugin interface for TinyMCE to configure table cells. It contains form elements, scripts, and styles for manipulating table cell properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function called on page load to set up the plugin UI.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Handles the submission of the form, applying the selected properties to the table cell.

methods.name: changedSize
methods.description: Handles changes to width and height inputs to update the cell size.

methods.name: changedStyle
methods.description: Handles updates to style attributes such as style and language direction.

methods.name: changedBackgroundImage
methods.description: Handles changes to background image property.

methods.name: updateColor
methods.description: Updates color properties for border or background.
